Bea (CSM): Heads-up: Glenwick reported slowdowns in their admin UI during morning syncs. p50 ~210ms, p99 jumps to ~680ms. Theyre hosted, typical prompts 120-250 tokens but a subset of analytics requests hit ~900 tokens. Id like to propose a low-risk perf play: scoped int8 canary for intake endpoints + prefix warmup and a token-length routing hedge. Thoughts?
Marco (Solutions Eng): Agree with scoped approach. Proposal: internal 5% synthetic -> 10% customer intake -> observe. Route long sequences (>512 tokens) to fp16 model to avoid potential semantic drift. Also prefix-cache TTL=30s for repeated system prompts.
Tao (Glenwick): Thanks Bea. Intake forms are fine to try. Please keep billing/official-doc flows on current model. We need rollback within 5 minutes if any errors.
Riley (Onboard PM): Ill schedule a 20-minute readiness call with Glenwick and confirm which endpoints are safe for the canary.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Draft route rule (infra snippet):
```yaml
- name: glenwick-intake-int8
  match: "header('x-glenwick-route') == 'intake' && request.tokens <= 512"
  variant: rw-llama-13b-int8-v2
  weight: 0.10
  fallback: rw-llama-13b-fp16-v3
```
Also recommending eval guard: run 150 golden prompts every 4h; auto-revert if semantic accuracy drops >1.5% or error rate +0.5%.
Bea (CSM): Marco, can you provide a conservative cost-savings estimate we can share with Glenwick finance? Tao, well include that in the call.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Ballpark: int8 should cut per-token GPU compute by ~30-35%; with prefix cache and fewer KV misses the effective tail cost on routed traffic could be ~40% lower. Will produce a short estimate doc.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: glenwick-int8-canary -> 2026-04-08T13:00Z, initial 5% synthetic then 10% customer intake, monitoring hooks enabled.
Bea (CSM): Action items: SE to push route + quant profile + cost note, Onboard PM to confirm endpoints and call, Ops to run warmup and enable auto-revert. Well post checkpoints here every 6 hours while canary runs. Tao, thanks for being flexible.
